summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments from automated reviewers (CodeRabbit/Copilot), fix the flagged issues, and push the changes.
summary.outcome: All 4 unresolved Copilot threads were addressed: error message copy fixed in recovery.html, type safety improved in byo-file-workload.ts, and ROADMAP.md formatting corrected. Changes were committed and pushed.

repo: v2 recovery only uses hex keys — base64 fallback in recovery.html was dead code from an old export-file mode and was removed
ROADMAP.md lives in .planning/ directory and contains phase-based planning with checklist items and progress tables

code.finding: cid was declared with definite assignment assertion (let cid!: string); changed to string | undefined with ! assertions at usage sites (lines 95, 147) since TypeScript cannot narrow cross-branch let assignments; finally block at line 167 already guarded with if (cid)
Error message said '64 hex characters' but code had a base64 fallback path — misleading and dead; base64 branch removed to match actual v2 behavior
Phase 24 had unchecked plan checklist items and misaligned progress table columns; both fixed

workflow: Running multiple background git push tasks concurrently can cause exit code 128 failures when one push succeeds and subsequent ones find nothing to push or a race condition
GraphQL reviewThreads API with isResolved filter is the right approach for fetching unresolved PR threads; REST comment replies use --field for integer in_reply_to, --raw-field for string body

friction: Multiple background bash tasks for git push ran concurrently and two failed with exit code 128 because the push was already completed by an explicit foreground push — redundant background task setup caused noise

TypeScript cannot narrow cross-branch let variable assignments, forcing ! non-null assertions at usage sites even after changing the declaration to string | undefined — the improvement is cosmetic/partial
open_items: The ! non-null assertions at byo-file-workload.ts lines 95 and 147 are still present — a fuller fix would restructure control flow so TypeScript can narrow without assertions
CI was still running at end of session — final green/red status not confirmed in transcript
